description: Source code implementing the XNNPack backend for PyTorch JIT, including classes for model wrapping and backend execution, with functions for compilation and execution of models.

classes.name: XNNModelWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class for XNNExecutor, used for managing model instances within the backend.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if the XNNPack backend is available by initializing the XNN library.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a serialized model into an executable form and wraps it in a model wrapper.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the compiled model with given inputs and returns the output tensors.
